svg.title: Homelab drawing set, sheet 3 of 3: Services (request paths, data and support)
svg.text: SERVICES — REQUEST PATHS, DATA AND SUPPORT
DRAWN BY make diagram FROM topology.yml · vars.yml · hosts.yml · guests.yml · nas.yml
AND THE RENDERED NETWORK TEMPLATES. EDIT THE REPO, NEVER THIS SHEET. REV = MODEL HASH.
DETAIL A — THE FRONT DOOR: EVERY LAB NAME, ONE CERTIFICATE
caddy_routes: https://<name>.lab.home.arpa, wildcard by DNS-01; A = admin sources only, C = also the CLIENT Wi-Fi
3 NAMES ON ONE HOST: photos, media, paperless
4 NAMES ON ONE HOST: agents, preview1, preview2, preview3
DETAIL B — FAMILY DATA: NFS, SHARES AND THE PULL
nas.yml of both nodes; all inside VLAN 60
DATABASES ON ITS DISK · FILES ON NFS
POOL backup · MIRROR OF 2 DRIVES → backup/syntex
PULL BY THE BACKUP · SSH AS repl · DAILY 01:00
TIERS DAILY · WEEKLY · MONTHLY · EXCLUDES syntex/timemachine
ports from the firewall and the vars
A LAB NAME RESOLVES TO CADDY ON THE PI-HOLES; CADDY HOLDS THE ONE WILDCARD CERTIFICATE AND PASSES EACH NAME
FW = A CADDY RULE IN THE FORWARD CHAIN LETS IT THROUGH; L2 = THE BACKEND IS ON CADDY'S OWN VLAN (20); NO RULE OR
NO HOST IN RED IS A ROUTE THAT CANNOT WORK AS DRAWN.
AN ADMIN ROUTE (A) ANSWERS THE TAILNET ROUTERS, THE ADMIN MAC AND THE ROCK PI ONLY; A CLIENT ROUTE (C) ALSO THE
THE BACKUP NAS PULLS: THE PRIMARY HOLDS NO CREDENTIAL TO IT. COLD DRIVES ARE NOT IN THE MODEL YET.
